The work below spans the research programs I lead at the U.S. EPA, the data
tools and collaborative trials I've contributed to, and the funded studies I've
taken part in. Each entry is drawn directly from my record.

## Research leadership {.eyebrow-heading}

Programs led under the EPA's Chemical Safety for Sustainability (CSS) Strategic
Research Action Plans (STRAP).

::: {.project-grid}

::: {.project-card}
[Output Lead · STRAP 4]{.tag}

### Building confidence in non-targeted analysis for exposure assessment

Leads CSS 402.6 — building confidence in the use of non-targeted analysis for
exposure assessment through applications.

[CSS 402.6]{.meta}
:::

::: {.project-card}
[Product Lead · STRAP 4]{.tag}

### Point-of-use water filters + NTA for CECs in drinking water

Using point-of-use water filters and non-targeted analysis to identify
contaminants of emerging concern in drinking water.

[CSS 402.6.4]{.meta}
:::

::: {.project-card}
[Product Lead · STRAP 4]{.tag}

### Increasing confidence in NTA using gas chromatography

Improving the reliability of non-targeted analysis identifications through
GC-based methods.

[CSS 402.6.5]{.meta}
:::

::: {.project-card}
[Product Lead · STRAP 4]{.tag}

### Characterizing household-material emissions during a fire

Applying non-targeted analysis to characterize emissions from household
materials during a fire.

[CSS 402.6.6]{.meta}
:::

::: {.project-card}
[Product Lead · STRAP 3]{.tag}

### NTA for rapid-response chemical characterization

Case-study application of non-targeted analysis for chemical characterization
in a rapid-response scenario.

[CSS 2.7.6]{.meta}
:::

:::

## Data tools & collaborative science {.eyebrow-heading}

::: {.project-grid}

::: {.project-card}
[Collaborative trial]{.tag}

### EPA Non-Targeted Analysis Collaborative Trial (ENTACT)

Co-chaired the ENTACT International Workshop (Durham, NC, 2018) and chaired
national-meeting sessions on its results. Contributed the in-house mixture and
house-dust performance findings (STAA Honorable Mention, 2021).

[Workshop Co-chair · 2018]{.meta}
:::

::: {.project-card}
[Cheminformatics tool]{.tag}

### CompTox Chemicals Dashboard Team

Member of the team behind EPA's CompTox Chemicals Dashboard, supporting
structure identification for non-targeted analysis.

[ORD Impact Award, 2018 · Bronze Medal, 2019]{.meta}
:::

::: {.project-card}
[Community · Standards]{.tag}

### Benchmarking & Publications for Non-Targeted Analysis (BP4NTA)

GC-NTA Committee Chair (2024–present) and former Website Committee Chair
(2020–2023) for the NTA community working group.

[[nontargetedanalysis.org](https://www.nontargetedanalysis.org)]{.meta}
:::

::: {.project-card}
[Editorial]{.tag}

### Guest Editor — special issue on NTA of the environment

Guest Editor for the special issue "Non-Targeted Analysis of the Environment"
in *Environmental Science & Technology* and *ES&T Letters*.

[2024]{.meta}
:::

:::

## Funded research (participant) {.eyebrow-heading}

Externally funded studies I contributed to:

- **Tapwater Analysis Project (TAP): Testing Chemicals in Drinking Water in California** — California Breast Cancer Research Program, California Breast Cancer Prevention Initiatives, 2019.
- **Fire and Water: Investigating Drinking Water Contamination in Paradise, California after the Camp Fire** — National Institute for Environmental Health Sciences, R21 program, 2019.
- **Application of community-engaged and discovery-driven methods to characterize drinking-water contaminants in disadvantaged communities and their perinatal health effects** — NIEHS Superfund Hazardous Substance Research and Training Program (application), 2021.

::: {.softnote}
Peer-reviewed outputs from many of these efforts are listed on the
[Publications](publications.qmd) page.
